en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, form Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr who said,
‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The meat builds the meat, and the one who enters inside him a morsel of fat, throws out the likes of it from the ailments’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “I once heard abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
Meat grows meat, but if one sends a morsel of shahm (fat) inside it expels the same amount of illness out.’”
